name: Thieves' Quarter
description: A crowded district of Paliano where Adriana makes her speech against Marchesa.

description_citations.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Adriana speaks to the crowd in the Thieves' Quarter, calling Marchesa's rule illegitimate and urging the people not to bow to her flag.
timeline.quote: Marchesa would have you stand with her, in service to a true crown resting upon a false head

citation.text: "Tyrants" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2016.
